# Accessible Text Discussion Roles

Subject: Differentiation and Special Education Support
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Discussion Roles
NYS framework label: NYS Learning Standards with UDL-aligned access supports

## Short Description
Structured discussion roles that make text conversations accessible and accountable.

## Alignment Note
Supports collaborative discussion, comprehension, language access, and student participation.

## Classroom Use Case
Use during literature circles, content reading groups, or co-taught lessons.

## Preview Content
- Evidence finder
- Question asker
- Connector to prior learning

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
